title: Anee, the AI Agricultural Technician Who Knows Your Farm
metaTitle: AI Agricultural Technician for Filipino Farmers: Anee
metaDescription: Anee is the AI agricultural technician inside anee.io. Ask in Tagalog or English, send a photo of a pest, and get answers that read your own farm first.
excerpt: Anee is the AI agricultural technician built into anee.io. Before she answers, she reads your cropping schedule, the growth stage of each lot and the weather at your farm, so her advice fits your field and not a textbook field. Ask her in Tagalog or English, at any hour, from any phone.

heroImage.alt: A farmer holds his phone in a palay field while Anee, the AI agricultural technician, reads a photo of his rice leaves

blocks.text: What an AI agricultural technician does for your farm

A good technician knows two things: crop science and your farm. Most answers you find online only know the first. Anee knows both, because she works inside the app where your season already lives.

Ask her 'Ano ang dapat kong gawin sa palay ko ngayong linggo?' and she first reads your season: the lots, their day counts, their growth stages and the forecast for each location. Then she answers in the language you used. If you wrote in Tagalog, the answer comes back in Tagalog. Palay, by the way, is rice still in its husk.

items: Pests and diseases, with a photo of the leaf, the stem or the insect itself
Fertilizer: which kind, how much per hectare and on which day of the count
Water: when to drain, when to flood, and what the coming rain means for a spray day
Weeds: what that grass or sedge is and when to control it
The plan: what comes next on your [cropping calendar](/features/cropping-calendar) and what to prepare this week

blocks.text: Show her a photo of the problem

Many field problems are easier to show than to describe. Tap the camera in the chat, take a clear photo in daylight and send it with your question. Anee looks at the picture, weighs it against your crop and its stage, and tells you what she sees and what to check next.

Treat her reading as a first opinion. If you need to spray, follow the product label and the FPA registration, and call your municipal agriculturist for a serious outbreak. Our guides on the [rice black bug](/problems/rice-black-bug) and the [brown planthopper](/problems/brown-planthopper) show what to look for in the field.
Analyses and reports she writes for you

Besides the chat, Anee runs longer jobs that land as full reports. You can keep each one and open it again later. The season report and Analyze So Far sit with the full report shelf, so they need Solo Farmer or Farm Owner.

items: **Season report**: after harvest she reads the activities, costs, yields and weather of the whole season and writes what went well and what to change. See [farm reports](/features/farm-reports).
**Analyze So Far**: a mid season reading of one lot, whether it is on track, and what to do next
**When to Plant and What to Plant**: the safer planting months for your town and the crops that fit your field, explained on the [when to plant analysis](/features/when-to-plant-analysis) page
**Variety Research and Comparison**: varieties for your crop, ranked by what matters to you
**Crop Protocol Analysis**: a season plan by growth stage for your crop, variety and planting month
**Protocol review**: she checks a plan you built in the [Protocol Builder](/features/protocol-builder) and marks its strengths, gaps and risks

blocks.text: Anee and the agricultural technician in the field

Anee does not replace a licensed agricultural technician who walks your paddies. She is also not an agricultural equipment technician who can fix your hand tractor or your water pump. She cannot touch the soil or smell a rotting stem.

What she gives you is an answer at any hour, even at nine in the evening before a spray day, when nobody else picks up the phone. Use her to prepare for the technician's visit too. Ask her first, write down her reading, and your hour with the technician goes further. If you are curious about the profession itself, read about the [agricultural engineer career](/blog/agricultural-engineer-career).

blocks.title: Ask with details
blocks.text: Name the lot, the variety, the day count and what you saw. 'Lot 2, NSIC Rc 222, DAT 35, may puting guhit sa dahon' gets a sharper answer than 'may sakit ang palay'.

Anee runs on credits. The chat shows what each question costs, and each analysis shows its price and your balance before you confirm. Every new account starts with 20 credits, kept ready for the day you add Anee.

The Libre plus Anee plan, at 70 pesos a month, opens the chat and every analysis. Solo Farmer adds 30 credits at each renewal and Farm Owner adds 100. On any plan with Anee you can buy a credit pack when you run low. The [pricing page](/pricing) lists the current plans.

items.q: Is Anee a licensed agricultural technician?
items.a: No. She is an AI agricultural technician, so use her for quick answers and planning. For field inspections, soil tests and anything that needs a signature, go to your municipal agriculturist or a licensed technician.

items.q: Can Anee tell a pest from a photo?
items.a: She can look at a photo of a pest or a sick plant and tell you what she sees and what to check. A sharp, close photo in daylight works best. Confirm in the field before you spray.
